pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped sub-polygonal patches with softened edge gradients. Individual patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower neck and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light-tan pathways. The network is characterized by numerous tri-point junction nodes and relatively uniform pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette formed by short, dark-brown mane hairs along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural discontinuity or thinning of the mane line is visible at the anatomical transition between the neck and the shoulder hump.
